description: Global landslide hazard map is a dataset listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia. The Global Landslide hazard map is a gridded dataset of landslide hazard produced at the global scale. Landslides happen around the world and have devastating impacts on people and the built environment. Coverage: Open Data Armenia. The publisher named on the listing is Open Data Armenia. Its keywords include Hazards, energydata.info, global, landslide, mapping, risk assessment. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, TIFF. The listing shows 2023-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
